data.name: Jacob
data.gender_notes: Jacob is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Supplanter; one who grasps the heel
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Yaʿaqov, from the root ʿ-q-b, 'heel' (Genesis 25:26). Its root is Hebrew ʿ-q-b. Jacob, son of Isaac (Genesis 25). Jacob is a Hebrew name meaning “Supplanter; one who grasps the heel”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jacob expresses “Supplanter; one who grasps the heel”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Yaʿaqov, from the root ʿ-q-b, 'heel' (Genesis 25:26).
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jacob total 13, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
